title: Game server
description: WebSocket game server (AGPL-3.0). Sequencer for move ordering, hidden state vault, cryptographic randomness, room/lobby management. Runs the same WASM engine as the client for move validation. Minimal — the server's irreducible role is hidden state, randomness, and sequencing. Option B WASM extensibility: server may host WASM modules that define new primitives for complex games.
